purpose.zh: 练臀部，让腿往后抬更有力
purpose.en: Build your glutes and a stronger backward leg lift.

text.zh: 夹紧臀部把腿往后抬，腰别往后仰
text.en: Squeeze your glute to lift the leg back without arching your back

text.zh: 双手扶椅背，上身稍微前倾。
text.en: Hold the chair back with both hands and lean slightly forward.

text.zh: 骨盆别歪，脚放回到支撑脚旁边。
text.en: Keep your hips level and bring the foot back beside your standing foot.

commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to lift the leg higher.
Turning the hips open to one side.

cautions.zh: 腰不舒服时抬低一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back feels uncomfortable, lift lower, and stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 用结实、不带轮子的椅子
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels.
